[NTST.13.2] **The report.** `ds_test_run`'s report lists the cases it ran in
ascending `test_id`. For each it gives:

- the case's `test_id`, its name, and its module ([RDSC.4.7]);
- one result per `Oracle*` atom of the case, in atom order: the assertion's
  head, its position among the case's assertions, whether it is a `NEVER`
  assertion, how many occurrences the run observed, and whether that count
  satisfies it ([RTIM.14.7]);
- every failure the case met that is not an assertion's count ([NTST.13.3]),
  each with its kind and a detail text;
- every fault event the case's engine raised, in stream order, each with what
  [RTIM.14.16] names of it;
- whether the case passed: it **must** be reported passed exactly when every
  assertion's result is satisfied and it has no failure.

The report is the caller's until it passes it to `ds_test_report_free`, and
every string in it lives as long as the report.
